critique.summary: Iteration 003 clears the bar. All four prior defects are resolved: the date/city subtitle is now 32pt/w600 white and clearly legible below the 80pt headline (was 16pt); the CTA pill is now a solid white #FFFFFF surface with a dark #111827 22pt/w800 label (was near-invisible #0F172A on #111827); and the CTA label is now well-sized and optically centered in the 340x72 pill. On the vertical-balance question, the ~296px below the subtitle is NOT a stranded dead band - with the enlarged subtitle the main focal block (kicker->headline->subtitle) sits as a coherent group, and there is comparable open space above the block (header at y=96, block starting ~y=436) as below it (block ends ~y=616, CTA at y=912). The slack now reads as intentional symmetric margin around a center-weighted focal group anchored between a pinned top header and a pinned bottom CTA - a common, deliberate poster idiom - rather than the bottom-heavy void of iteration 001. Squint test passes: event name dominates, date/city reads, CTA reads. Hierarchy, contrast (WCAG), alignment spine, clipping, and brand fit all pass; no imagery axis triggered (deliberate no-hero decision is appropriate).
